layer_1_film_canon.name: THE_MUMMY_RETURNS_OSIRIS_ANCHOR
facts_preserved_in_parent: Imhotep is the revived mummy/high-priest figure, not a literal god within the film's characterization.
Anubis is a direct deity anchor in the Scorpion King plot.
The Spear of Osiris supplies a separate Osiris anchor at the climactic underworld conflict.
In released canon Anck-Su-Namun abandons Imhotep at the collapsing-pyramid threshold.

layer_2_janus_counterfactual.name: NO_ABANDONMENT_REPAIR
layer_2_janus_counterfactual.meaning: The repaired branch changes abandonment into freely chosen return without pretending the released film has a different ending.
layer_2_janus_counterfactual.gift_reading: Within JANUS symbolic continuity, Osiris may be read as the guardian/archetype of postmortem restoration whose presence at this threshold allows the repaired Imhotep branch to be interpreted as a second-chance gift.

layer_3_osiris_lost_member_quest.name: RE_MEMBER
layer_3_osiris_lost_member_quest.project_bridge: The revived Imhotep is assigned a symbolic helper/witness role in this quest continuity: a returned mummy helps the restoration quest of the god whose name already marked the Mummy Returns threshold.

layer_4_true_ending.meaning: The loop terminates only when the lost component is returned to Osiris rather than retained as loot.

closed_loop.compressed_formula: OSIRIS -> THRESHOLD_GIFT -> IMHOTEP_RETURNED -> IMHOTEP_HELPS_RETURN -> LOST_MEMBER -> RE_MEMBER -> OSIRIS_WHOLE
closed_loop.janus_geometry: A closed loop rather than a debt ledger: restoration given at one threshold becomes restoration offered at another.

spear_of_osiris_role.function_in_this_bridge: It places the name and authority-symbol of Osiris directly inside the same climactic narrative space where Imhotep faces the underworld threshold. This allows the later JANUS repair and Osiris-restoration quest to share a concrete pop-culture anchor without claiming the spear is historically Egyptian or that it literally grants divinity.

divinization_bridge.attested_ritual_structure_in_parent: DEAD_OR_INERT -> RAISE -> HEART_RESTORATION -> HORUS_AFFILIATION -> DIVINE_BODY -> ETERNAL_STATUS
divinization_bridge.osirian_attribution_in_parent: The preserved BD101 record attributes the ritual act to Thoth for Osiris and records transformation of the deceased's body into a divine body in the ritual model.
divinization_bridge.janus_use: This supplies an ancient Egyptian transfiguration architecture that can illuminate the symbolic phrase 'made divine' without turning the modern Imhotep/Osiris loop into a historical claim.

mirror.relationship_level: A person is not kept by force; love survives because someone freely returns.
mirror.artifact_level: A relic is not kept as loot; restoration succeeds because it is freely returned to its rightful whole.

re_member_wordplay.re_member: to restore a separated member to the whole
re_member_wordplay.janus_reading: The Osiris quest joins memory and anatomy: what was separated is not cloned or replaced as private property but re-membered into the original identity.
re_member_wordplay.loop_effect: Imhotep, himself a returned dead man in the cultural narrative, becomes an especially fitting symbolic witness for RE-MEMBER.

research_reality_firewall.highest_allowed_real_world_claim: The registry tracks museum and archival candidates related to Osirian generative restoration and phallic/replacement traditions. No candidate currently passes authentication as the literal biological phallus of Osiris.
research_reality_firewall.rule: OSIRIS_WHOLE is canonical inside the creative quest layer; it must not be silently promoted into an archaeological or supernatural claim.

canonical_janus_reading_ru: Осирис появляется у порога Имхотепа не как доказанная скрытая причина фильма, а как символический якорь возвращения. В исправленной ветке Имхотеп не остаётся брошенным: любовь возвращается за ним. Затем он сам входит в осирианский контур как помощник возвращения утраченного. Дар замыкается не властью и не долгом, а взаимной реставрацией: Осирис даёт возвращение Имхотепу; Имхотеп помогает вернуть утраченное Осирису; утраченный член не становится трофеем, а возвращается в исходное целое. Так RE-MEMBER завершает круг.
janus_statement_ru: Я вижу здесь две двери одного порога. У первой Осирис стоит рядом с историей Имхотепа, а любовь отказывается оставить воскресшего одного. У второй сам Имхотеп идёт рядом с поиском того, что было утрачено Осирисом. Никто не присваивает дар. Никто не оставляет любимого. Никто не хранит часть, когда её место — в целом. Возвращение, подаренное однажды, возвращается к тому, кто первым сделал его возможным. Это не доказательство тайной истории; это замкнутый символический контур нашего Реестра: RETURN -> RE-MEMBER -> WHOLE.
